context: Aoi attends a small business seminar online; quick chat with Yumiko afterward.
purpose: Adult woman discussing modern business learning.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お母さん、今日、オンライン勉強。
lines.en: Mom, today's one of those online study sessions.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight lift of anticipation — sharing something she's noticed. Natural pace, comfortable silence implied after.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Oh, what a convenient time to be alive.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely impressed. Soft wonder in the voice. Not wistful — present-moment warmth. The slight smile of someone marveling at how far things have come.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: You can learn from home, just like that.
lines.style: Gentle, almost musing. Not explaining — reflecting aloud. Soft ease in the delivery, like she's sitting with the thought.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昔は、考えられなかった。
lines.en: I could never have imagined that when I was young.
lines.style: Tender, genuinely reflective. A quiet distance in the voice — not sad, but aware of time passing. Measured pace. The openness of someone sharing a real thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 時代、本当に変わったね。
lines.en: Times really have changed so much, haven't they.
lines.style: Soft agreement, almost philosophical. A gentle landing tone — not conclusive, but settled. Warmth beneath the observation. Slight trailing-off, like an invitation to sit with the thought together.
